scripts.dev:electron:build: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --outDir electron-dist --declaration false --declarationMap false --sourceMap false && mv electron-dist/main.js electron-dist/main.cjs && mv electron-dist/preload.js electron-dist/preload.cjs
scripts.dev:electron: npm run dev:electron:build && npm run dev:electron:start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:vite" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build:vite: npm run copy-audio-assets && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:electron-main: tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --outDir electron-dist --declaration false --declarationMap false --sourceMap false && mv electron-dist/main.js electron-dist/main.cjs && mv electron-dist/preload.js electron-dist/preload.cjs
scripts.build: npm run build:vite && npm run build:electron-main
